heroBody: TEDxNortheasternU London is a student-run organisation bringing together bold thinkers to share ideas that matter.
introParagraph: We are part of the global TEDx community — a grassroots network of events that bring the spirit of TED to local communities around the world.
pullQuote: Every student has an idea worth spreading.
closingParagraphEvent: Our inaugural event, Ideas. Change. Everything., took place on 26 March 2025, bringing together 8 speakers — students and industry leaders — to share ideas that challenge assumptions and spark conversation.
closingParagraphMission: We believe that every student has an idea worth spreading. Our mission is to create a space where those ideas can be heard, celebrated, and acted upon.
ctaBody: Whether you want to join the team, attend our next event, or watch the talks from our inaugural event — there's a place for you here.
